method.direction: No published support/oppose count; existing machine stance polarity is not validated.
method.attribution: Original participant quotes can be reported by a different filer. NTIA listening-session summary excluded from agency-position topic tallies; context flags and identity uncertainty retained.
method.review: All category counts are exploratory. A lower-risk count does not imply substantive human verification.
method.coverage_limitation: No extracted claim for a topic does not mean a filing lacks that argument, particularly with long filings or OCR.
